dct_description_sm:
Includes data required to create York Region Official Plan – 2010 Map 10: Regional Cycling Network.  The data includes York Region’s existing  and proposed Cycling Network on regional and non-regional roads.

The data layers do not take the place of a legal survey or other primary source documentation and may not be used to determine, certify, or verify if a parcel is a qualifying or exempt property.
dct_rights_sm: Please refer to "York Region Open Data Licence", searchable on this website.
